thread:
noah_pm: Quick question: can we standardize a 'migration window' field for catalog entries so sales/legal can lock windows per-customer? Proposal: migration_window: {start_iso, end_iso, timezone, freeze_type}. Thoughts?

rachit_eng: +1. We should support multiple windows and an override flag for emergency security patches. Implement as metadata; console shows calendar blocks.

maria_sre: From SRE: freeze_type needs options: 'no-upgrades', 'no-auto-ramp', 'monitor-only'. Also require an API to force-unfreeze with audit log.

clare_sales: Sales needs a UI affordance to attach signed contract clauses to a migration window. Also surface any pending pins that fall inside a customer's migration_window.

rfc-bot: New RFC created: rfc/migration-window-1750012345 (link: https://redwood.in/rfc/1750012345)

noah_pm: Action items: @rachit_eng add schema + console calendar mock, @maria_sre auth & audit, @clare_sales contract attachment UX. Review Fri 15m.
